sections.content: You know the present perfect (*han subido*, A2 Unit 1), *estar* + gerund (*están bajando*, A1 Unit 19) and *más … que* (A2 Unit 6). Here you use them to describe how prices change, with the verbs *subir*, *bajar*, *aumentar* and *disminuir*.

items.spanish: Los precios han subido este año.
El coste de la vivienda ha aumentado mucho.
items.english: The cost of housing has increased a lot.

items.spanish: Algunos productos son más caros que antes.
items.english: Some products are more expensive than before.

items.spanish: Los precios están bajando poco a poco.

sections.content: Say the direction (*subir*, *bajar*) and the degree (*mucho*, *poco a poco*), not only that something is different.
